parameter_semantics: source_object and destination_object select the observed source and bowl poses used for causal relative-error features. Learned actions are local SE(3) targets relative to the freshly measured TCP and do not expose actuator parameters.
output_semantics: Each slot is a one-step Cartesian TCP target relative to the fresh measured TCP at that slot: body-frame translation xyz in metres, body-frame rotation vector xyz in radians, and one native gripper scalar. The decoder exponentiates the rotation vector, right-composes the local transform with current world TCP pose, then calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured joints. Slots represent t-1 through t+14 and execution uses slots 1 through 8. Gripper values retain the native >=0 open, <0 close rule.

conversion_check.description: For a demonstrated slot, compose its encoded local transform with that slot's measured TCP and compare FK of the IK output to the demonstrated commanded TCP in metres/radians; the gripper scalar is unchanged. Rotation-vector exp/log is exact on the observed small-step support.

cut_relation: Uses every assigned [0,360) occurrence without trimming and preserves the full action-supervised [180,360) overlap. It refines the approved invocation contract into fresh-state local feedback rather than changing responsibility.
